title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #16 (Term 1)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which of these is a good use of your talents? (1 mark)
   A. Helping others with them
   B. Boasting about them
   C. Using them to hurt people
   D. Hiding them always

2. What is the best way to respond when someone teases you about your appearance? (1 mark)
   A. Change your name
   B. Tease them back
   C. Stop going to school
   D. Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues

3. Which is an example of a good thought? (1 mark)
   A. I will take my friend's book
   B. I will not greet anyone
   C. I hope she falls
   D. I will help my mother with the dishes

4. What should you do first when you must make a difficult choice? (1 mark)
   A. Do what your friends do
   B. Stop and think
   C. Ask nobody
   D. Choose quickly without thinking

5. Who is your cousin? (1 mark)
   A. The child of your aunt or uncle
   B. Your mother's sister
   C. Your father's father
   D. Your teacher

6. Who is included in the nuclear family? (1 mark)
   A. Only grandparents
   B. Parents and their children
   C. Neighbours
   D. Cousins and aunts only

7. Which number can a child in Kenya call for help, as given in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. 300
   B. 116
   C. 100
   D. 555

8. What is one warning sign that a situation is unsafe? (1 mark)
   A. You feel happy
   B. You feel uneasy or scared
   C. You feel sleepy
   D. You feel proud

9. What is an attribute of God? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A kind of building
   C. A quality that describes what God is like
   D. A holiday

10. Which action shows that we care for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Wasting food
   B. Hurting animals
   C. Planting trees and saving water
   D. Cutting trees for fun

11. How many books are in the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 39
   C. 21
   D. 66

12. Which of these is a Gospel? (1 mark)
   A. John
   B. Psalms
   C. Romans
   D. Acts

13. What did Jesus say to Zacchaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Come down, I must stay at your house today
   B. Go away
   C. Sell your house
   D. Follow me to Jerusalem

14. What did Jesus say about why He came? (1 mark)
   A. To build a palace
   B. To collect taxes
   C. To seek and to save the lost
   D. To rule Rome

15. What should we do instead of cursing or speaking ill about others? (1 mark)
   A. Gossip
   B. Speak well of them and bless them
   C. Spread rumours
   D. Insult

16. What did the angel tell Balaam to do at the end? (1 mark)
   A. Kill the donkey
   B. Curse Israel
   C. Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   D. Go home forever

17. What does it mean to acknowledge God's power? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore God
   B. To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   C. To hide our talents
   D. To boast about ourselves

18. What is a famine? (1 mark)
   A. A festival
   B. A long time when there is not enough food
   C. A feast
   D. A river

19. What is a patriarch? (1 mark)
   A. A soldier
   B. A prophet
   C. The father and leader of a family or nation
   D. A king

20. How old was Abram when God changed his name? (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 75
   C. 50
   D. 99

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Give three ways in which a child can protect themselves from sexual abuse. (3 marks)

22. State three lessons that we learn from the story of Joseph interpreting the dream. (3 marks)

23. Describe four ways in which a child can trust God in life's challenges. (4 marks)

24. Describe Joseph's plan to save Egypt from the famine. (4 marks)

25. Give three ways in which children can care for animals. (3 marks)

26. Describe what a child should do step by step if someone touches them wrongly. (4 marks)

27. Write the first three books of the New Testament in order. (2 marks)

28. Describe how Abram showed obedience when God called him. (4 marks)

29. Give three ways in which God helps us today. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Helping others with them
   Talents are gifts from God meant to serve others.

2. D — Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   God's view of you matters more than unkind words.

3. D — I will help my mother with the dishes
   Helping at home is a thought that leads to kindness.

4. B — Stop and think
   Thinking first helps us to choose well.

5. A — The child of your aunt or uncle
   Cousins are the children of your uncles and aunts.

6. B — Parents and their children
   The nuclear family is the small group of parents and children living together.

7. B — 116
   Childline Kenya can be reached free on 116.

8. B — You feel uneasy or scared
   Uneasy feelings are a signal to move away.

9. C — A quality that describes what God is like
   An attribute is a quality that describes someone.

10. C — Planting trees and saving water
   Caring for the environment honours the Creator.

11. A — 27
   The New Testament has 27 books.

12. A — John
   The four Gospels are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John.

13. A — Come down, I must stay at your house today
   Luke 19:5 records Jesus asking to stay at his house.

14. C — To seek and to save the lost
   Luke 19:10 says that the Son of Man came to seek and save the lost.

15. B — Speak well of them and bless them
   God's people are called to bless, not curse.

16. C — Go with the men but speak only what God tells him
   God allowed him to go but ordered him to speak only His words.

17. B — To admit that our strength comes from Him and thank Him
   Acknowledging means to accept and thank.

18. B — A long time when there is not enough food
   A famine is a serious shortage of food.

19. C — The father and leader of a family or nation
   Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are called patriarchs.

20. D — 99
   Genesis 17:1 says he was ninety-nine.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, run away, do not accept gifts from strangers, avoid being alone in hidden places, tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Depend on God; do not give up when life is unfair; use gifts to serve others; save for hard times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray; read the Bible; ask trusted adults; do their best; thank God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way, up to 4.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Find a wise man to be in charge, take a fifth of the grain during the seven good years, store it in the towns, and use it in the famine years.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Give them food and water; protect them from harm; do not beat them; do not overload them; give them shelter.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: Say no loudly, move away quickly to a safe place with people, shout for help if needed, tell a trusted adult right away even if told to keep it secret.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 4.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Matthew, Mark, Luke.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two correct in order, 2 marks for all three correct.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: He left his country, his people and his father's household. He went to a land he did not know. He took his wife, nephew and belongings. He was seventy-five years old.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: He gives courage, wisdom, the power to forgive, healing and protection, and talents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.
